description: This file contains implementation details for helper classes related to path emulation within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It defines constructors for classes that emulate absolute paths, incorporating parameters like current working directory and home directory.

classes.name: EmulateAbsolutePathBase
classes.description: Base class for emulating absolute path conversions, initialized with a path to convert and an expected path.

classes.name: EmulateAbsolutePathWithPwd
classes.description: Derived class that extends EmulateAbsolutePathBase to include a current working directory for path emulation.

classes.name: EmulateAbsolutePathWithHome
classes.description: Derived class that extends EmulateAbsolutePathBase to include a home directory for path emulation.

methods.name: EmulateAbsolutePathBase()
methods.description: Constructor initializing input and expected paths for path emulation.

methods.name: EmulateAbsolutePathWithPwd()
methods.description: Constructor initializing input path, expected path, and current working directory.

methods.name: EmulateAbsolutePathWithHome()
methods.description: Constructor initializing input path, expected path, and home directory.
